_meta.note: Authored source of truth for the DB catalog + generated shared/catalog_data.py. Keys derive from labels: attire_key = snake(label), ref = '<category>.<attire_key>', image_key = kebab(label). Image path composed per gender: /catalog/<gender>/<attires|backgrounds>/<image_key>_<gender>.jpg. Only prompt phrases are hand-authored. Labels are copied verbatim from the source JSON so they match the /public/catalog filenames.
